pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which folk songs are sung when young people become adults in their community? (1 mark)
   A. Naming songs
   B. Work songs
   C. Initiation songs
   D. Topical songs

2. When singing, you should breathe (1 mark)
   A. deeply so your tummy moves out gently
   B. only through the ears
   C. by holding your breath
   D. by shouting

3. Which is the first step in mixing green? (1 mark)
   A. Put red and black on the palette
   B. Use only white
   C. Put yellow and blue on the palette
   D. Use only water

4. How does gymnastics help the heart and lungs? (1 mark)
   A. It removes the lungs
   B. It has no effect
   C. It stops the heart
   D. Moving the whole body makes the heart beat faster and stay strong

5. Where should you stay during a sprint race? (1 mark)
   A. On the grass beside the track
   B. Across all lanes
   C. In your own lane
   D. In any lane

6. A flat brush is best for (1 mark)
   A. wide areas
   B. writing with ink
   C. cutting paper
   D. tiny details only

7. Tonguing means (1 mark)
   A. singing loudly
   B. rolling on the floor
   C. saying too or doo quietly at the start of each note
   D. chewing

8. How should you behave when the anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Stand straight and quietly
   B. Run around
   C. Talk to friends
   D. Play games

9. A well known children's song that uses only m r d is (1 mark)
   A. The national anthem
   B. A song with many notes
   C. Hot Cross Buns
   D. A drum solo

10. The middle note of d, r and m is (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. d
   C. none
   D. r

11. Which Kiswahili word means crab? (1 mark)
   A. simba
   B. mamba
   C. chura
   D. kaa

12. Why use a camera strap? (1 mark)
   A. So the camera does not drop
   B. To cover the lens
   C. To keep it wet
   D. To make it heavy

13. A portfolio is (1 mark)
   A. a song
   B. a ball
   C. a folder for keeping creative works together
   D. a kind of paint

14. Works on display should be kept away from (1 mark)
   A. water, direct sun and dust
   B. walls
   C. shelves
   D. other pictures

15. Why is gymnastics described as not being a race? (1 mark)
   A. It is about control and quality, not speed
   B. It uses no body
   C. It cannot be seen
   D. It is always in the dark

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain the steps of a full sprint from the start commands to the finish. (5 marks)

17. Explain why netball is called a team game. (2 marks)

18. What are the sol-fa syllables for the three notes learned, and which is the lowest? (2 marks)

19. What are indigenous games? (2 marks)

20. Describe the game hawk and the chicks. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Initiation songs
   Initiation songs mark the change from child to adult.

2. A — deeply so your tummy moves out gently
   Deep breathing supports the voice.

3. C — Put yellow and blue on the palette
   Green comes from yellow and blue.

4. D — Moving the whole body makes the heart beat faster and stay strong
   Active movement strengthens the heart and lungs.

5. C — In your own lane
   Running in your lane prevents crashes.

6. A — wide areas
   Flat brushes cover wide areas quickly.

7. C — saying too or doo quietly at the start of each note
   Tonguing separates notes clearly.

8. A — Stand straight and quietly
   An anthem is sung with respect.

9. C — Hot Cross Buns
   Hot Cross Buns uses only three notes.

10. D — r
   Ray lies between doh and me.

11. D — kaa
   Kaa is a crab.

12. A — So the camera does not drop
   A strap protects the device from falls.

13. C — a folder for keeping creative works together
   It protects and presents works.

14. A — water, direct sun and dust
   Water, sun and dust can damage works.

15. A — It is about control and quality, not speed
   Skill and control matter more than speed.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: On your marks: go to the line and take the position. Set: lift the hips slightly and stay still. Go: push hard and swing the arms. Run in your lane with high knees and bent arms. Keep running through the finish line and slow down gradually.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for marks, set, go, running technique and finishing.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Players must pass to each other to move the ball and score. No player can run with the ball alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for passing or cooperation, 1 mark for the explanation.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: d, r and m. d is the lowest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for naming, 1 mark for the lowest.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Traditional games that belong to a people and were passed on from long ago.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hen stands in front and chicks hold on behind in a line. A hawk tries to tag the last chick. The hen spreads her arms and blocks. When the last chick is tagged, roles change.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid part.
